Picks the bus that the channels of [PlayMusic](PlayMusic) start on. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
music = CreateAudioBus()
MusicBus music
PlayMusic "theme.ogg", 1
```
@param bus  A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error.
